name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A packaged set of senior-engineer habits (plan, build, test, review, ship) that an AI coding assistant follows automatically, instead of writing sloppy first-draft code.
buyer: A startup engineering lead whose AI-generated code keeps needing rework because the assistant skips tests and proper planning.
business_use_cases: A dev team installs it so every AI-assisted change goes through the same plan-build-test-review steps a senior engineer would insist on, cutting rework.
A consultancy uses it as their standard operating procedure for AI-assisted client work, so quality doesn't depend on which contractor is driving the AI that day.
A coding bootcamp teaches it to students as 'how professional teams actually use AI coding tools', a differentiator from AI-hype-only courses.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid workshops teaching teams how to adopt structured AI coding workflows
Build and sell industry-specific skill packs (e.g. for fintech compliance) as an add-on

steal_this: This weekend, build one extra skill tailored to a specific stack (e.g. Django or Rails) that the base set doesn't cover, and offer it as a paid add-on pack.
